entry.intro: Draft dice and build a stained-glass window over ten rounds. Two to five players; computer players can fill any empty seats.

lathe.name: Lathe
lathe.text: Change a die in the pool by one shade, up or down. A 6 cannot become a 1, nor a 1 a 6.
lathe.how: Choose a pool die, then raise or lower it.

exchange.name: Exchange
exchange.text: Swap a die from the pool with a die on the round track.
exchange.how: Choose a pool die, then a die on the round track.

refire.name: Re-fire
refire.text: Roll one die in the pool again.

kiln.name: Great Kiln
kiln.text: Roll every die in the pool again. Only on your second turn of the round, before you place a die.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.text: Turn a die in the pool over to its opposite face (1 and 6, 2 and 5, 3 and 4).

slide.name: Slide Rule
slide.text: Move one die in your window to another space, obeying every placement rule.
slide.how: Click the die to move, then the space to move it to.

twin.name: Twin Slide
twin.text: Move exactly two dice in your window, one after the other, obeying every placement rule.
twin.how: Click a die and its new space, then a second die and its space.

tint.name: Tint Shifter
tint.text: Move one die in your window, ignoring the colour of the space it moves to (shades and neighbours still count).
tint.how: Click the die to move, then the space to move it to.

gauge.name: Gauge Breaker
gauge.text: Move one die in your window, ignoring the shade of the space it moves to (colours and neighbours still count).
gauge.how: Click the die to move, then the space to move it to.

echo.name: Track Echo
echo.text: Move one or two dice in your window, all of one colour that also appears on the round track, obeying every placement rule.
echo.how: Click a die and its new space (and a second die of the same colour and its space).

free-pane.name: Free Pane
free-pane.text: Place a die from the pool on any space that accepts it, even one that touches nothing (neighbours of the same colour or shade still count). This is your die for the turn.
free-pane.how: Choose a pool die, then the space.

swift-hand.name: Swift Hand
swift-hand.text: On your first turn of a round, take a second full turn straight after this one (choose another die, use more favour tokens if you wish). You then skip your second turn of the round.
swift-hand.how: Just confirm, then finish this turn as usual: your extra turn starts at once.

pale-pairs.name: Pale pairs
pale-pairs.text: Pairs of a 1 and a 2, anywhere in the window.

middle-pairs.name: Middle pairs
middle-pairs.text: Pairs of a 3 and a 4, anywhere in the window.

deep-pairs.name: Deep pairs
deep-pairs.text: Pairs of a 5 and a 6, anywhere in the window.

full-spectrum.name: Full spectrum
full-spectrum.text: Sets of all six shades, anywhere in the window.

full-palette.name: Full palette
full-palette.text: Sets of all five colours, anywhere in the window.

colour-chains.name: Colour chains
colour-chains.text: Each die that touches a die of its own colour diagonally.

notes.exchange: swapped a pool die with one from the round track
notes.kiln: re-fired every die in the pool
notes.slide: slid a die in their window
notes.twin: slid two dice in their window
notes.swift-hand: will take an extra turn now, and skip their second turn

scores.provisionalText: They count public objectives, favour tokens and empty spaces. Private objectives are added at the end, and each is shown only to its owner until then. Round 1 includes everyone's starting tokens less their 20 empty spaces.
scores.finalNote: Final scores include the private objectives (the last row).

final.result: {names} wins with {points} points. | {names} share the win with {points} points.
final.ruleNote: Private objective rule: {rule}. Ties are broken by private objective, then favour tokens, then whoever moved last in the final round.
final.ruleBad: bad private scoring (a flat 3 per die of the colour)
final.ruleNormal: the shade of every die of the colour, added up
final.hostAgain: The host can start another game, or leave (top right).

private.ruleBad: Bad private scoring is on: each of your private-colour dice is worth a flat 3, whatever it shows.
private.ruleNormal: Each die of this colour in your window scores its shade (pips).
private.textBad: Each die of your colour scores a flat 3.
private.textNormal: Each die of your colour scores its shade.
